name: Express todo API
description: An Express API with a shell command built from input, eval on a query parameter, SHA-1 password hashing and a hard-coded session secret. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Findings from the JavaScript token scanner. The SQL string in /todos is only built, not executed, so it is not flagged.

fixes.title: Read the session secret from the environment
fixes.explanation: The secret is no longer in the repository.

fixes.title: Use execFile with an argument array
fixes.explanation: No shell parses the directory name.

fixes.title: Parse JSON instead of eval
fixes.explanation: JSON.parse reads data and cannot execute code.

fixes.title: Hash passwords with scrypt and a salt
fixes.explanation: A random salt and a memory-hard hash replace unsalted SHA-1.
